descriptor: Modular type scale explorer for designers

voice.summary: Sounds like a designer explaining a system to a colleague: calm, exact, mildly opinionated. It shows the steps and trusts the ratio.
dos: Give ratio, base size and steps in plain numbers
donts: No type jargon without a gloss
No dogma about one true ratio

taglines: Choose a ratio, then trust it
Copy the scale, keep the system
boilerplate: Scalewise is a type scale tool that turns a base size and ratio into a full hierarchy, previews it on a live article and exports ready CSS variables.

microcopy.empty: Pick a base size and ratio to see the scale

logo.note: Rising bars of different heights show the steps of a scale.
